# Prime Detailing NSW
> High-end mobile car detailing and ceramic coating service based in Sydney’s Northern Beaches. We specialise in paint correction, long-term protection, and premium results delivered at your location.

Important notes:
- Fully mobile service covering Northern Beaches and surrounding Sydney areas, no shop visits required
- Focused on high-end detailing, paint correction, and ceramic coatings, not cheap express washes
- Results-driven service with professional-grade equipment, designed for long-term vehicle protection and resale value

## Core Services (High Priority)
- [Mobile Car Detailing](https://primedetailingnsw.com/mobile-detailing/): Full-service mobile detailing with exterior and interior restoration at your location
- [Ceramic Coating](https://primedetailingnsw.com/ceramic-coating/): Long-term paint protection with gloss enhancement, hydrophobic properties, and easier maintenance
- [Pre-Sale Detailing](https://primedetailingnsw.com/pre-sale-detailing/): Designed to maximise resale value through deep cleaning, correction, and presentation
